verdict.rationale: Letta keeps memory as Markdown files in a Git-backed memory repository (MemFS), and the default local mode keeps agent state on your own machine. That makes the memory store inherently inspectable and copyable, and a Letta employee describes the memory as text/files-based and transparent. However, no documented export command, export API, or defined interchange format appears in the evidence. Portability therefore follows from the storage design rather than from a first-class export feature. Missing for 10: a documented memory export command or API, a structured machine-readable export schema (e.g. JSON) including metadata, a documented import path into other tools, and independent hands-on confirmation of migrating memory out.
